first_line: The paper's numbers partly hold up: 3 of 3 checked results match within their uncertainty. Its main result is none of the numbers checked, so it was not judged. Sample size not rebuilt: exact posterior HMC in rank(K)<=T via 32 chains 300 burn 700 retained not rebuilt - Laplace approximation used, so exact timing/MCSE/Rhat not computed (RevExactDates, 605 in the paper).

rejections.reason: the script writes the paper's sample count as a result's count, or cuts its sample to it (RevExactDates (605) at line 297). Build the sample from the paper's definition and report the count you get; never trim, cut or pad it to a reported count.
